coverage.complete_year_rule: first session <= Jan 10 and last session >= Dec 20

calendar.window_convention: start_doy/end_doy are 1-based day-of-year; cum index = doy - 1; window log return = cum[end_doy - 1] - cum[start_doy - 1] (enter at the start_doy close, exit at the end_doy close)

family.start_days: 1..365, restricted so start + horizon <= 365 (windows never wrap the year)
family.registered_panel_pricing: every registered row is priced against the maximum over the 2645-window grid; month rows whose length is not in horizons_days are not themselves grid members
